title.zh: 分子三通道散射源归约

summary: The source-order sum Swall + Beta_CX + OmegaM of the molecular wall, charge-exchange and elastic scattered-generation normalized spatial source distributions (Q/Vth, in F/m) on one velocity-space mesh, preserving signed values.

capability: The source-order sum Swall + Beta_CX + OmegaM of the molecular wall, charge-exchange and elastic scattered-generation normalized spatial source distributions (Q/Vth, in F/m) on one velocity-space mesh, preserving signed values.
operation: sum the molecular scattered-generation source channels
three aligned source fields -> their pointwise sum in the declared order
discovery.model: the scattered-source aggregation; normalized spatial transport with u=v/Vth and inverse-length collision coefficients
discovery.geometry: two velocity dimensions over one spatial axis; velocity axes are dimensionless u=v/Vth on one common caller normalization
discovery.boundary: three finite aligned three-dimensional fields; signed values preserved

identity.relation: Beta = Swall + Beta_CX + OmegaM pointwise on one (nvr,nvx,nx) mesh
identity.direction: three aligned source fields -> their pointwise sum in the declared order
identity.definition: Plain pointwise addition in the order wall, CX, elastic; no clamping of signed values
identity.geometry: two velocity dimensions over one spatial axis
identity.coordinates: All input and output source fields are Q/Vth in F/m (m^-4 when F is m^-3), on one common dimensionless u=v/Vth velocity grid.
identity.boundary: three finite aligned three-dimensional fields; signed values preserved
assumptions: The wall-source channel exists only on the molecular side; this is why the molecular reduction is a separate asset from its atomic sibling.
The caller owns the per-channel source construction; this asset only aggregates.

Fail-closed finiteness: extreme-but-valid inputs can overflow, so this asset rejects a non-finite result instead of returning it, per the declared finite-output contract. A bounded regression test pins that behaviour.

The public transport convention is u=v/Vth on one caller-selected thermal-speed scale: alpha=nu/Vth has units m^-1, F integrates over normalized velocity volume to number density in m^-3, and every spatial source coefficient is Q/Vth in F/m. Physical rates in s^-1 must be divided by that same Vth before this spatial operator; no automatic conversion is performed.

inputs.name: wall_source_distribution
inputs.constraints: A finite three-dimensional field; signed values preserved.

inputs.name: charge_exchange_source_distribution
inputs.constraints: A finite three-dimensional field aligned to the wall field.

inputs.name: elastic_source_distribution
inputs.constraints: A finite three-dimensional field aligned to the wall field.

outputs.name: total_source
outputs.constraints: The pointwise sum in the declared order; finite; signed values preserved.

preconditions: Use one common Vth for normalized velocity nodes, inverse-length collision coefficients and spatial source coefficients; the callable performs no implicit unit conversion.
supported: Molecular generation-source aggregation on a shared mesh.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for non-real/boolean/string/complex or nonfinite source values, or when the three sources are not aligned 3-D arrays.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError when the signed aggregate is not finite; no clipping, channel drop or fallback is applied.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; the reduction is a direct pointwise sum.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Never returned; a rejected call produces no partial array.

example.description: Aggregate three molecular sources in the declared order and reject misalignment.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import reduce_molecular_scattered_sources
rng = np.random.default_rng(31)
wall, cx, elastic = (rng.random((2, 3, 4)) for _ in range(3))
result = reduce_molecular_scattered_sources(wall, cx, elastic)
np.testing.assert_array_equal(result, wall + cx + elastic)
try:
    reduce_molecular_scattered_sources(wall, cx, np.ones((2, 3, 5)))
except ValueError as error:
    assert 'finite aligned 3-D' in str(error)
else:
    raise AssertionError('a misaligned field must be rejected')
example.expected: The returned field equaled wall + charge_exchange + elastic elementwise, and a misaligned 3-D field raised ValueError.

scope: Direct tests bind wall/CX/elastic addition order, signed values, shape validation and overflowing-total rejection.
The cross-domain tests consume real CX and elastic source producers with a zero wall channel, then compare the physical RHS and velocity-integrated number balance.
The contract example covers one bounded representative call; numerical checks do not establish external physical validation or full-domain applicability.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded to the stated normalized transport relation. Direct tests bind wall/CX/elastic addition order, signed values, shape validation and overflowing-total rejection. The cross-domain tests consume real CX and elastic source producers with a zero wall channel, then compare the physical RHS and velocity-integrated number balance. The listed direct and cross-domain tests are the current reproducible evidence; the example exercises one bounded call. Independent analytic and SI-unit comparisons are limited to the stated fixtures. Unbound historical source/parity receipts remain UNKNOWN and are not re-established here.
known_limitations: No external collision-data calibration, source-project parity qualification or device-specific physical validation is established by these tests.
The normalization tests use bounded aligned meshes and prescribed rates; they do not certify full-distribution grid convergence, arbitrary-step positivity or the complete nonlinear transport model.
